caption:
Kids home all Thanksgiving weekend? Print a cozy Christmas page and hand them the crayons. 🎄

My new Cozy Christmas book has 45 coloring pages with bold, thick lines and big, easy shapes. Santa, a snowman, a kitten in a gift box, a log cabin in the snow. One design per page.

It's simple enough for kids, and relaxing enough that you might grab a page yourself.

The pages are 8.5 x 8.5 in squares. You get one complete PDF plus every design as JPG, PNG, EPS and SVG, and you can print at home as many times as you like.
